shortBulletSummary: Crypto Fear & Greed Index hit 46, a three-month high, signaling improved sentiment.
Bitcoin held above $77,000, supported by a short squeeze and positive spot ETF inflows.
Geopolitical tensions between the US and Iran, including ceasefire developments, impacted crypto volatility.
Ethereum saw price gains and continued institutional support from spot ETF inflows ahead of its June 'Glamsterdam' upgrade.
The Bank for International Settlements (BIS) warned about risks of crypto firms offering banking services, while Q1 retail crypto volume declined due to macro factors.
